description: Decision-structure skeletons for Geranium batch uniqueness. Portal Uniqueness fails when two tasks share a skeleton even with different nouns. Map every scaffold to exactly one skeleton; reuse of a skeleton is a hard gate error.

fx_acquisition_consolidation.label: Multi-entity FX + mid-period acquisition consolidation
fx_acquisition_consolidation.decision_shape: ledger rebuild + FX conversion + acquisition proration → consolidated totals + controller notes

renewal_path_routing.label: Insurance renewal desk Quote/Refer/Decline routing
renewal_path_routing.decision_shape: account vs location/loss conflicts → underwriting path decision workbook

live_formula_valuation.label: Live-formula valuation / cap-table model
live_formula_valuation.decision_shape: cohort + cap table + brief conflicts → formula model + sensitivity + notes

trueup_reconcile.label: Rebuild eligible amounts vs prior billings → true-up settlement
trueup_reconcile.decision_shape: rebuild pool/premium from source → apply governing rules → compare to billed/deposit → settle
trueup_reconcile.blocked_reason: Portal Uniqueness FAIL (Pelliston attempt 1 vs Meridian). Do not add another true-up scaffold.

si_reserve_rollforward.label: Self-insured reserve: case + IBNR + retention + rollforward
si_reserve_rollforward.decision_shape: case inventory + retention/excess + AY IBNR factors → liability rollforward + booking rec

covenant_headroom_pack.label: Credit / loan covenant headroom and exception pack
covenant_headroom_pack.decision_shape: debt schedule + EBITDA bridge + covenant defs → headroom workbook + exception memo
covenant_headroom_pack.blocked_reason: Portal Uniqueness FAIL (Northline attempt 1). Do not add another lender re-test of borrower covenant certificate scaffold.

intercompany_settlement.label: Intercompany balance settlement with FX and cut-off
intercompany_settlement.decision_shape: AR/AP mirrors + FX + cut-off disputes → settlement worksheet + netting recommendation

claims_reserve_triangle.label: Insured/claims-side triangle + case vs IBNR (non-SI program)
claims_reserve_triangle.decision_shape: loss triangle + open inventory + actuarial factors → reserve opinion (distinct from SI retention corridor)

claims_coverage_determination.label: Single-claim coverage determination + case reserve
claims_coverage_determination.decision_shape: policy/endorsements + loss notice + investigation notes → coverage decision + case reserve (not portfolio triangle/IBNR, not SI rollforward)

commercial_loan_underwriting.label: Commercial loan Approve / Conditional / Decline underwriting pack
commercial_loan_underwriting.decision_shape: borrower financials + collateral/appraisal + credit policy → path decision + exception documentation (new facility request, not existing-facility covenant retest)

gl_flux_close_pack.label: Month-end GL flux analysis + adjusting entry close pack
gl_flux_close_pack.decision_shape: current vs prior TB + support schedules + materiality/threshold rules → material flux explanations + proposed AJEs + close readiness (not consolidation, not IC settlement, not billed true-up)

notes: valuation / consolidation / renewal already have 2 tasks — prefer a FREE skeleton from available_for_new_tasks.
trueup_reconcile is CLOSED after Pelliston Uniqueness FAIL.
covenant_headroom_pack is CLOSED after Northline Uniqueness FAIL vs existing portal covenant work.
gl_flux_close_pack is IN USE (haverford) — Treasurers and Controllers (11-3031.01); Accountants 13-2011.00 is NOT Finance & Insurance sector-valid.
When inventing a scaffold, add its name under the chosen skeleton in this file BEFORE gf seed register.
